name: japan-port-vessel-mcp
display_name: Japan Port Vessel Traffic MCP (AIS Position & ETA)
description: Real-time AIS vessel tracking across 20 Japanese ports. Covers position, ETA, delay estimation, port call summaries.
long_description:
Japan Port Vessel Traffic MCP — OpenWaters AIS free API for Japanese port monitoring.

## Tools

| Tool | Description |
|---|---|
| `list_japan_ports()` | Return catalog of 20 major Japanese ports with bounding boxes |
| `get_vessels_in_port(port_code, limit)` | Live vessel snapshot within a port |
| `get_vessel(mmsi)` | Latest position, name, IMO, flag, ETA, destination for one vessel |
| `get_vessel_track(mmsi, hours, interval, limit)` | Historical track as GeoJSON coordinates |
| `estimate_vessel_eta(mmsi, port_code)` | Compare AIS-reported ETA with speed-projected ETA; delay estimate |
| `get_port_overview(port_code, max_age_hours)` | Port activity summary: counts by type/flag/status, fastest vessels |

## Source

- Open Waters AIS (ais.openwaters.io): free, no API key, aggregate community receivers.
- Attribution required; see source/station fields in responses.

## Requirements

- Python >= 3.10
- fastmcp, mcp
- No keys / credentials needed (anonymous tier works for all tools)
- stdio transport; HTTP optional via FastMCP built-in.

## Related

- Kensho: https://github.com/atushi1841/kensho
- AIS: https://openwaters.io/ais/

tools.name: list_japan_ports
tools.description: Return a catalog of major Japanese ports with bounding boxes for AIS queries.

tools.name: get_vessels_in_port
tools.description: Return vessels currently within the named Japanese port bounding box.

port_code.description: ISO-like port code. Call list_japan_ports for valid codes.

tools.name: get_vessel
tools.description: Fetch the latest known position and static information for a vessel by MMSI.

mmsi.description: nine-digit Maritime Mobile Service Identity. Leading zeros preserved.

tools.name: get_vessel_track
tools.description: Return the past trajectory of a vessel as GeoJSON-style positions.

hours.description: how far back (defaults to 24h, up to 366d).

tools.name: estimate_vessel_eta
tools.description:
Estimate a vessel's arrival at its reported destination port.

Compares the AIS-reported ETA (`eta` field) against a speed-based projection
to infer delay. Also shows distance and travel-time estimates.

port_code.description: optional explicit port code to validate destination against.

tools.name: get_port_overview
tools.description:
Aggregated overview of a Japanese port's vessel traffic.

Returns counts by vessel type, flag, and navigation status.
